svg.title: Head-to-tail method for the city walk
svg.desc: (a) The first displacement: 9 units along +x, θ = 0°. (b) The second displacement, 5 units in the +y direction, drawn from the head of the first. (c) The resultant D from the tail of the first to the head of the second, at a right angle corner; a ruler alongside D reads 10.3 units and a protractor reads θ = 29.1°.
